mapper.select: select sku, on_hand, reserved, note from stock_item where sku = #{sku}
select sku, on_hand, reserved, note from stock_item where sku = #{sku} for update
mapper.insert: insert into stock_item (sku, on_hand, reserved) values (#{sku}, #{onHand}, 0)
mapper.update: update stock_item set reserved = reserved + #{delta} where sku = #{sku}
update stock_item set on_hand = on_hand + #{delta} where sku = #{sku}
update stock_item set on_hand = on_hand - #{qty}, reserved = reserved - #{qty} where sku = #{sku}
